headline: Weird and Wonderful, the Lucas Museum Lands in L.A.
context: A billion-dollar behemoth that looks like a spaceship houses the art collection of the “Star Wars” filmmaker George Lucas and his wife, Mellody Hobson. It’s an instant landmark.
